The National Museum in Delhi is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. Tomorrow, Fri 13 Nov, it should be open 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, unless it is a holiday. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 get in free with an ID card. This is from the museum's own Plan Your Visit page, and I did not check the holiday calendar.
